_readme: One-off report jobs, run by hand: npm run report -- <job name>.
Edit this file to change what a job covers; keys starting with _ are comments.
period: 7d | 30d | 90d | 6mo (or a plain day count). email: false builds the
documents in sme_reports/out and sends nothing. Flags override per run:

customer.description: One customer's Magnet Health Summary, by customer id
customer._scope: give exactly one of customer_id, site_ids, system_ids

sme.description: Magnet Health Brief for one or more MRI systems

fleet.description: Internal fleet summary — every mag-processed system
